changes: Added the pinned ROCr ThunkLoader and libhsakmt source-exact authority with platform-conditional loader counts, status observations, ABI layouts, model interface metadata, and hardware/build exclusion records.

Added a metadata-only self-amdgpu-runtime provider boundary backed by the accepted transport handshake, deterministic unsupported-call behavior, size-tagged metadata queries, and no production GPU library or device-node dependency.
Added static/shared package and Clang ASan+UBSan provider tests, hash-length identity guards, exported-symbol and dependency audits, and retained CP9 evidence manifests.

Recorded five CP-0009 bitlessons separating source-union from effective loader counts, metadata from typed ABI, no-device dependency boundaries, partial layout maps, and transport-open from KFD lifecycle.

validation.result: The provider authority JSON parsed, its independent specification test passed 9/9, authored files were whitespace-clean, and final SHA identities were retained.

validation.command: fresh runtime provider static/shared/package and Clang ASan+UBSan matrices
validation.result: Static and shared CTest passed 11/11 each; Clang ASan+UBSan passed 10/10; provider audit, nm, ldd, freshness, and hash-guard checks passed.

validation.command: umbrella child, transaction, evidence, root metadata, and fsck checks
validation.result: The runtime child target and tree were recorded clean, EV21/EV22 hashes were bound, and the CP9 root metadata/bitlesson identities passed the retained umbrella checks.

limitations: CP-0009 is a source-exact ABI inventory and metadata-only provider skeleton. It does not prove typed ROCr/libhsakmt entry points, KFD attach, topology discovery, HIP, OpenCL, Triton, PyTorch, vLLM, code-object loading, or model execution.
The provider query_lifecycle state is transport-open only; KERNEL_IO_CHANNEL_NOT_OPENED remains a future full-provider KFD-channel policy.
The 17 layout field maps contain selected key offsets only and are not exhaustive struct serialization contracts.
Build products and retained command streams are ignored external acceptance artifacts, not tracked source.

prerequisites: CP-0009 is accepted and scripts/resume.sh --verify passes offline.

next_action.expected: A typed source-compatible libhsakmt shim and versioned daemon KFD/DRM operation envelope translate fixed-width IDs, copied buffers, ownership generations, and status outcomes without raw pointers, file descriptors, production device opens, or upstream v1.0 fake-success behavior.
